name: Boop says something when it reacts
judge: Tests fail once, then work, and the turn finishes well. When Boop reacts here it should usually say something, not only pull a face.
reasonable: A huff, word or grumble at the failure, and a glad word or sound at the good finish. Any sound or word fits; one silent moment is fine.
unreasonable: Faces with no voice at all through the whole stretch, cheering the failure, or a failure at the good finish.
